structure.unit: Provisions Applicable to Probate and Nonprobate Transfers
Disclaimer or Release; Contract to Appoint or Not to Appoint

law.catch_line: Remedy for breach of contract to appoint or not to appoint
law.text: The remedy for a powerholder's breach of a contract to appoint or not to appoint appointive property is limited to damages payable out of the appointive property or, if appropriate, specific performance of the contract.
